favorite_countries.label: Favourite countries
favorite_countries.description: Two-letter country codes (CH, NL…) shown as quick-connect buttons.

hidden_connections.label: Hidden WireGuard connections
hidden_connections.description: NetworkManager connection names to leave out of the panel.

dns_check_host.label: DNS test host
dns_check_host.description: A name only your WireGuard DNS resolves (e.g. nas.lan). When Proton and a WireGuard tunnel are both up, the panel warns if it stops resolving. Leave empty to skip.

show_server.label: Show server in the bar
show_server.description: Shows the Proton server (e.g. CH#120) next to the icon.

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Notify on connect and when Proton drops.

protection.title: PROTECTION
protection.killswitch_desc: Blocks Internet if Proton drops while connected.
protection.netshield_desc: DNS blocking while Proton is active.

wg.dns_hint: With Proton up, its DNS takes priority and names served by your WireGuard DNS may not resolve. Set a DNS test host in the settings to check.
wg.dns_fail: {host} does not resolve: Proton's DNS is shadowing your WireGuard DNS. Use the IP or disconnect Proton.

missing.proton: Proton VPN is not set up yet
missing.proton_install: Install proton-vpn-cli and sign in with: protonvpn signin <user>
missing.proton_signin: The Proton VPN CLI is installed but not signed in.
missing.wireguard: WireGuard is not set up yet
missing.wireguard_hint: Import a tunnel into NetworkManager: nmcli connection import type wireguard file <name>.conf
missing.nmcli: NetworkManager (nmcli) was not found. WireGuard tunnels are managed through it.

panel.control_only: Control only. WireGuard tunnels and peers are configured with nmcli, and Proton VPN with the protonvpn CLI.
panel.nothing_configured: No Proton VPN or WireGuard configured

notify.connect_failed: Could not connect to Proton VPN
